cohort: Newborns of 1036 mothers with diabetes mellitus (including both pregestational and gestational diabetes) admitted to a hospital nursery between January 2018 and December 2020.
finding: Newborns of mothers with pregestational diabetes had a significantly higher risk of hypoglycemia, LGA birthweight, NICU admission, RDS, and needing gavage feeding compared to newborns of mothers with gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Mothers with pregestational diabetes had a significantly higher risk of needing an emergency cesarean section compared to mothers with gestational diabetes (OR: 2.1, 95% CI: 1.3-3.4).
